material.acceptance_criteria: After two hot reloads of ui_minimap.js, the minimap canvas has one pointerdown and one pointermove listener, and window has one pointerup listener from this module; a press calls centre() once.
material.description: Fact: createMinimap (js/client/ui_minimap.js:38-197) adds pointerdown and pointermove listeners to its canvas (js/client/ui_minimap.js:186, 191) and a pointerup listener to window (js/client/ui_minimap.js:194). The file contains no removeEventListener. hot.set (js/client/ui_minimap.js:39) keeps the canvas, and hmrReload (js/client/ui_minimap.js:202-205) calls createMinimap again on that same canvas. Callers: js/client/hmr.js:47, js/client/play.js:2360, js/client/play.js:2561. Each hot reload stacks one more set of three listeners and the earlier closures keep running. Symptom: a press on the minimap calls centre() once per stacked set, and the listener count grows by three per reload.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: ui_minimap.js:186 (pointerdown), :191 (pointermove), :194 (window pointerup) add listeners; the file has no removeEventListener; hot.set at :39 keeps the canvas; hmrReload at :202-205 re-runs createMinimap on it; hmr.js:45-48 calls it on each reload. Observable: each hot reload stacks three listeners, and one press calls centreAt once per stacked set, sending camera_to once per set (hud.js:71). Reads: ui_minimap.js 1-205 dispatch 1792859429070-6387-47df82884af9e433; hmr.js 40-50 dispatch 1792859566909-6458-42517b6029f594e7.

material.subject: Minimap hot reload stacks pointer listeners on the same canvas
material.witness: Live Chrome (cdp, session verify-SLAP-trav-minimap-camera-1) at fix sha 1ed26ddd: one createMinimap, then two hmrReload calls, then one real mouse press on the canvas gave 1 centre call (dispatch 1792862806593-5339-1b65f5bd25e13b44). Control parent 4ee45ed6 under the same harness gave 3 (dispatch 1792862817076-5347-15fd6233e30e694b): each reload stacked a listener set. CI for 1ed26ddd: ci workflow success (run 40115088976).
material.witness_plan: In the dev page console, read getEventListeners on the minimap canvas and on window before and after two hmrReload calls; the counts for this module must not rise.
